source: Notorious brain-wallet passphrases; drainage pattern documented by Ryan Castellucci, DEF CON 23 (2015), “Cracking Cryptocurrency Brainwallets”
note: A brain wallet turns a passphrase into a key with a single SHA-256 — so a human-chosen phrase is one guess, not 2^256. Automated bots watch for these and have swept funds within seconds of them being funded. The phrases below all produce real, well-known Bitcoin addresses that anyone can regenerate instantly.
